row: Look at the gauge on your left. It shows your device's remaining energy. For this training, energy is protected.
Outside training, time control continuously consumes energy. Watch the gauge now. Then press Q again when prompted to restore time.
With time control off, energy recharges automatically. Release it in time, and save energy for your next move.

methods: S1 uses mapped Enhanced Input movement/Q and waits for real dialogue completion.
S2 sends mapped movement against the actual bullet path; first/second time toggles call the original ToggleTimeAbility after opening the tutorial input gate, without physical keyboard simulation.
Energy demonstration uses the current saved drain and actual ability ticking; energy recovery uses the unchanged native recovery rate.
Interruption fixtures call public teaching helpers and PrepareRetry/EnterExercise for cost, drain, recovery and repeated S2 spawn cleanup.
